notes: The 'for' goes to קָרָאתִי's unit under rule 44, since the object חֶרֶב carries no marker or preposition of its own. Note that the verb's unit is in fact contiguous here (t002–t005); the accepted note's mention of discontinuity is inexact, but the unit and head are right.
'every man's' is read as the whole rendering of the rectum אִישׁ, including its distributive sense, leaving 'sword' to the construct (rule 19).
